changelog:
proactive-agent v3.1.0 introduces new protocols and improvements for proactive, self-improving AI agents.

- Added Autonomous vs Prompted Crons section to clarify scheduling approaches
- New guidance to verify implementation mechanisms, not just intent
- Introduced a Tool Migration Checklist for safer tool deprecation
- WAL Protocol, Working Buffer, and Compaction Recovery now formally documented
- Expanded security hardening and persistent memory architecture sections
summary: Transform AI agents from task-followers into proactive partners that anticipate needs and continuously improve. Now with WAL Protocol, Working Buffer, Autonomous Crons, and battle-tested patterns. Part of the Hal Stack 🦞
